Alex / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. I attached our network-allowlist.pdf with the outbound IP ranges and the ports we use for the managed runtime. High level runbook outline below — we’ll drop a full runbook into the shared drive before the meeting.

Runbook highlights (high level):
1) Pre-cutover validation (30m) — schema tests, prefix cache warming, smoke traffic to staging endpoints
2) Cutover window (90m) — model switch, traffic split, short-burst acceptance tests
3) Monitoring/verification (30m) — latency/throughput checks, top-10 error traces, manual sign-off
4) Rollback (if criteria met) — revert to previous model version + cache flush; target rollback time <= 15m

Owner assignment proposal:
- Cutover owner: Aditya Rao (redwood) — executes model switch and validates logs
- Rollback owner: Alex Huang (acme) — triggers rollback if acceptance tests fail
- Monitoring/acceptance owner: Monica Patel (redwood) — coordinates verification and sign-off
- Procurement sign-off owner: procurement@acmehealth.com — provides PO before cutover

We’ll also surface a small SLA-exception request during the meeting for the 48-hour monitoring window post-cutover.

Attachments: network-allowlist.pdf

—Aditya
